title: Box Breathing Reset
note: Breathe in for 4 seconds. Hold for 4 seconds. Breathe out for 4 seconds. Repeat for 1 minute.

title: 5 Senses Reset
note: Notice 5 things you can see. 4 things you can feel. 3 things you can hear. Let your breathing slow as you go.

title: Tension Release Stretch
note: Roll your shoulders. Stretch your neck gently. Unclench your jaw. Let the tension drop a little.

title: Daylight Reset
note: Step outside or stand in daylight. Stay there for around 6 minutes and let your body wake up.

title: Hydration Reset
note: Pour a glass of water. Drink it slowly before moving on to the next thing.

title: Focus Space Reset
note: Clear 1 small part of your desk. Keep only what you need for the next task.

title: Next Step Reset
note: Write down the very next action you can do in under 5 minutes. Start with that one.

title: Campus Walk Reset
note: Take 1 short walk around campus or outside your building. Keep the pace easy and steady.

title: Kind Message Check-In
note: Send 1 short message. Ask how someone is doing or let them know you are thinking of them.

title: Tea Reset Break
note: Make a warm drink. Sit down for a moment. Let the break feel like a real pause.

title: Energy Boost Reset
note: Do a quick set of easy movements. Try marching squats or wall pushups for around 5 minutes.

title: Calm Track Pause
note: Play 1 calming track. Do nothing else until it finishes.

title: Fresh Air Pause
note: Open a window or stand near fresh air. Take a few slower breaths while you do.

title: Top 3 Focus Plan
note: Write down your top 3 priorities. Circle the one you will start first.

title: One-Song Reset
note: Put on 1 song. Tidy or reset your space until it ends. Then stop.

title: 3 Good Things
note: Write 3 small things that went well today. Add a few words about why they mattered.

title: Mindful Walk Break
note: Walk slowly. Notice your steps. Notice your breathing. Notice what is around you.

title: Easier Task Restart
note: Switch to the easiest useful task on your list. Stay with it for 5 minutes.

title: Wrist Relief Stretch
note: Stretch your fingers wrists and forearms gently. Shake out your hands when you finish.

title: Mood Lift Track
note: Play 1 song that reliably lifts your mood. Let yourself listen to it properly.

title: Posture & Breath Reset
note: Sit tall. Drop your shoulders. Place both feet on the floor. Take 5 slow breaths.

title: Nourishing Snack Break
note: Make a simple snack that feels steadying. Eat it without rushing.

title: One-Page Restart
note: Read 1 page of notes. Underline 1 point that matters most.

title: Light Boost Pause
note: Step into natural light for 2 minutes. Look up from your screen and let your eyes reset.

title: Social Walk Plan
note: Send 1 message with a simple plan to walk or catch up later.

title: Set Up Tomorrow
note: Leave out tomorrow's notes clothes or bag. Make the morning easier to begin.

title: Guided Calm Reset
note: Play a short guided calm or breathing video. Follow it all the way through.

title: Stair Boost Break
note: Walk up and down a staircase or do a quick movement burst. Let it wake up your focus.

title: Mind Clear Dump
note: Write down everything on your mind without editing. Stop when your head feels lighter.

title: Sensory Reset
note: Pause and name what you can see hear feel smell or taste right now.

title: Phone-Free Focus
note: Put your phone out of reach. Turn it face down. Begin the task in front of you.

title: Tea Chat Break
note: Invite someone for a short tea or coffee break. Keep it light and easy.

title: Evening Wind-Down Stretch
note: Do a few slow stretches in low light. Let your pace feel quieter than the rest of the day.

title: Sleep Breathing Pause
note: Lie or sit comfortably. Take 5 slow breaths before trying to sleep.

title: Walk & Call Reset
note: Call someone while you walk outside. Keep the pace easy and relaxed.

title: 10-Min Focus Sprint
note: Set a 10-minute timer. Pick 1 task. Stay with it until the timer ends.
